```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(scales)
library(flextable); library(knitr)
set_flextable_defaults(font.family = "Latin Modern Roman")   # match 11_results.qmd

## ── WHICH RUNS TO COMPARE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BASE_RUN  <- "gcam_ref"     # reference run (the official results)
ALT_RUN   <- "bau"          # alternative land-cover run
SHORT_B   <- "GCAM ref"     # short names for table headers and legends
SHORT_A   <- "BAU"
THRESH_PP <- 2              # flag a headline gap that moves by more than this (pp)
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

source("00_config.R")        # for DIR_COMMON (shared EAU grid); run folders are set above
run_dir <- function(id, sub) file.path("runs", id, sub)

read_meta <- function(id) tryCatch(
  jsonlite::read_json(file.path(run_dir(id, "output_figs"), "run_metadata.json"),
                      simplifyVector = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
meta_b <- read_meta(BASE_RUN); meta_a <- read_meta(ALT_RUN)
lab_of  <- function(m, id) if (!is.null(m$lc_label)) m$lc_label else id
date_of <- function(m) if (!is.null(m$generated_date)) m$generated_date else "unknown"
LAB_B <- lab_of(meta_b, BASE_RUN); LAB_A <- lab_of(meta_a, ALT_RUN)

load_run <- function(id) {
  od <- run_dir(id, "output_data"); pf <- file.path(run_dir(id, "derived_data"), "data_panel.rds")
  sf <- file.path(od, "acquisition_schedule_spatial.csv")
  list(res   = read_csv(file.path(od, "model_results.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
       trj   = read_csv(file.path(od, "model_trajectories.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
       sch   = if (file.exists(sf)) read_csv(sf, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL,
       panel = if (file.exists(pf)) readRDS(pf) else NULL)
}
B <- load_run(BASE_RUN); A <- load_run(ALT_RUN)
have_panels <- !is.null(B$panel) && !is.null(A$panel)
have_sched  <- !is.null(B$sch)   && !is.null(A$sch)

lk <- file.path(DIR_COMMON, "eau_wmd_lookup.rds")
eau_xy <- if (file.exists(lk)) readRDS(lk)[, c("eau_id", "x_coord", "y_coord")] else NULL
have_xy <- !is.null(eau_xy)

## ── labels, palettes, constants (as in 10_results_assets.R) ───────────────────
SCEN_LEVELS <- c("rcp45_wet", "rcp45_dry", "rcp85_wet", "rcp85_dry", "stationary")
SCEN_LAB1   <- c(rcp45_wet = "RCP 4.5 wet", rcp45_dry = "RCP 4.5 dry",
                 rcp85_wet = "RCP 8.5 wet", rcp85_dry = "RCP 8.5 dry",
                 stationary = "Stationary")
CLIM <- SCEN_LEVELS[1:4]
BEN_MAP_SCEN <- "rcp85_dry"              # scenario shown in the 2100 benefit panel (Fig. 1)
CELL_W <- 18513.54; CELL_H <- 18485.21  # EAU tile size, metres
COL_MODEL <- c(greedy = "#B0413E", myopic = "#E2A23B", rolling = "#2E7D5B")
RUN_COL   <- c(b = "#4D4D4D", a = "#C0392B")
RUN_LAB   <- c(b = SHORT_B, a = SHORT_A)
GREEN_HEADER <- "#2E7D5B"
MAX_TBL_W    <- 6.2       # text width of the PDF page, inches (tables are scaled to fit)
DIV_LO <- "#B0413E"; DIV_HI <- "#2C7FB8"   # diverging maps: red = lower in ALT, blue = higher

theme_cmp <- function() theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0))
theme_map <- function() theme_void(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

## ── formatters ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fmt_pairs <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", ifelse(abs(x) < 1, "<1",
                         formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")))
fmt_spairs <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", ifelse(abs(x) < 1, "0",
                          paste0(ifelse(x > 0, "+", ""), formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","))))
fmt_p1  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%.1f%%", x))
fmt_p2  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", ifelse(x < 1e-4, "<0.0001%", sprintf("%.2f%%", x)))
fmt_pp1 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%+.1f", x))
fmt_pp2 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%+.2f", x))
fmt_rel <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x), "\u2014", sprintf("%+.1f%%", x))
fmt_rk  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "\u2014", ifelse(x < 0.01, sprintf("%.3f%%", x), sprintf("%.2f%%", x)))
rng0 <- function(x) sprintf("%.0f\u2013%.0f%%", min(x), max(x))
rngp <- function(x) paste0(fmt_pairs(min(x)), "\u2013", fmt_pairs(max(x)))
DELTA <- "\u0394"

## ── table style (same look as 11_results.qmd) ─────────────────────────────────
## df: first column = row label; groups/subs: top and second header row for the
## value columns; bold_cells: list of c(row, col) to emphasise (flagged changes).
style_cmp_table <- function(df, groups, subs, footer_text = NULL, bold_cells = NULL,
                            first_lab = "Scenario") {
  vcols <- names(df)[-1]
  rle_g <- rle(groups)
  seps  <- c(1, head(1 + cumsum(rle_g$lengths), -1))
  bd    <- officer::fp_border(color = "#dddddd", width = 1)
  ft <- flextable(df)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = setNames(as.list(c("", subs)), names(df)))
  ft <- add_header_row(ft, top = TRUE, values = c(first_lab, rle_g$values),
                       colwidths = c(1, rle_g$lengths))
  ft <- merge_at(ft, i = 1:2, j = 1, part = "header")
  ft <- bg(ft, part = "header", bg = GREEN_HEADER)
  ft <- color(ft, part = "header", color = "white")
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
  ft <- bold(ft, j = 1, part = "body")
  if (nrow(df) > 1) ft <- bg(ft, i = seq(2, nrow(df), by = 2), bg = "#f5f5f2", part = "body")
  for (bc in bold_cells) ft <- bold(ft, i = bc[1], j = bc[2], part = "body")
  for (bc in bold_cells) ft <- color(ft, i = bc[1], j = bc[2], color = "#B0413E", part = "body")
  ft <- border_remove(ft)
  ft <- hline(ft, i = 1, part = "header", border = officer::fp_border(color = "white", width = 1))
  ft <- vline(ft, j = seps, border = bd, part = "all")
  ft <- padding(ft, padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 8.5, part = "all")
  ## Column widths come from the header and body only. They are measured BEFORE
  ## the footer is added: a long footer line would otherwise be counted as a
  ## column's content and push the table off the page. If the natural widths
  ## exceed the text width, the font steps down once and the columns are scaled
  ## to fit; with a fixed layout, header text then wraps instead of overflowing.
  wv <- dim_pretty(ft, part = "all")$widths
  if (sum(wv) > MAX_TBL_W) {
    if (sum(wv) > 1.2 * MAX_TBL_W) {
      ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 7.5, part = "all")
      wv <- dim_pretty(ft, part = "all")$widths
    }
    wv <- wv * min(1, MAX_TBL_W / sum(wv))
  }
  ft <- width(ft, width = wv)
  ft <- set_table_properties(ft, layout = "fixed")
  if (!is.null(footer_text)) {
    ft <- add_footer_lines(ft, values = footer_text)
    ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 7.5, part = "footer")
    ft <- color(ft, color = "grey40", part = "footer")
    ft <- align(ft, align = "left", part = "footer")
  }
  ft
}

## ══ MODEL RESULTS (same formulas as 10_results_assets.R) ══════════════════════
pct_improve <- function(roll, base) ifelse(abs(base) < 1e-9, NA_real_, 100 * (roll - base) / base)
pct_short   <- function(roll, base) ifelse(abs(roll) < 1e-9, NA_real_, 100 * (roll - base) / roll)
summ <- function(res) {
  va <- res %>% select(scenario, model, value_added) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = value_added)
  jb <- res %>% group_by(scenario) %>% summarise(J_baseline = first(J_baseline), .groups = "drop")
  va %>% left_join(jb, by = "scenario") %>%
    transmute(scenario, greedy, myopic, rolling, J_baseline,
              rg_d = rolling - greedy, rm_d = rolling - myopic,
              rg_imp   = ifelse(abs(rg_d) < 1, NA_real_, pct_improve(rolling, greedy)),
              rm_imp   = ifelse(abs(rm_d) < 1, NA_real_, pct_improve(rolling, myopic)),
              rg_short = ifelse(abs(rg_d) < 1, NA_real_, pct_short(rolling, greedy)),
              rm_short = ifelse(abs(rm_d) < 1, NA_real_, pct_short(rolling, myopic)),
              greedy_ob  = 100 * greedy  / J_baseline,
              myopic_ob  = 100 * myopic  / J_baseline,
              rolling_ob = 100 * rolling / J_baseline,
              order_ok = rolling >= myopic - 1e-6 & myopic >= greedy - 1e-6)
}
cmp <- inner_join(summ(B$res), summ(A$res), by = "scenario", suffix = c("_b", "_a")) %>%
  mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = SCEN_LEVELS)) %>% arrange(scenario)
clim <- cmp %>% filter(scenario %in% CLIM)
scen_lab <- unname(SCEN_LAB1[as.character(cmp$scenario)])

## headline numbers for the summary text
order_all <- all(clim$order_ok_b) && all(clim$order_ok_a)
d_rg <- clim$rg_imp_a - clim$rg_imp_b
d_rm <- clim$rm_imp_a - clim$rm_imp_b
max_shift <- max(abs(c(d_rg, d_rm)), na.rm = TRUE)
n_flag    <- sum(abs(c(d_rg, d_rm)) > THRESH_PP, na.rm = TRUE)
roll_chg  <- 100 * (clim$rolling_a - clim$rolling_b) / clim$rolling_b
```

```{r}
cap_fig_benefit_ribbon <- paste0("**Per-EAU duck-pair abundance to 2100, by scenario and land-cover run** (Fig. 2 of the main results). Line = median across EAUs; band = interquartile range. Grey = ", SHORT_B, "; red = ", SHORT_A, ".")
cap_fig_risk_box <- paste0("**Per-period conversion risk across EAUs, by decade, emissions scenario and land-cover run** (Fig. 3 of the main results). Box = median and IQR; diamond = mean; dash = maximum. Grey = ", SHORT_B, "; red = ", SHORT_A, ".")
cap_fig_cum_risk <- paste0("**Change in cumulative conversion probability, 2020\u20132100, per EAU (", SHORT_A, " \u2212 ", SHORT_B, ", percentage points).** Cumulative probability = 1 \u2212 the product of (1 \u2212 per-period risk) over the modelled decades, i.e. the 1 \u2212 S term in the acquisition value. Red = higher risk under ", SHORT_A, "; blue = lower.")

cap_fig_foresight_alt  <- paste0("**Rolling vs. myopic acquisition sets, ", SHORT_A, "** (Fig. 6 of the main results, as drawn for this run). Purple = both policies; blue = rolling only; orange = myopic only.")
```

**Reference run:** `r LAB_B` (`r BASE_RUN`; results generated `r date_of(meta_b)`)\
**Alternative run:** `r LAB_A` (`r ALT_RUN`; results generated `r date_of(meta_a)`)

Every figure and table below mirrors one in the main results document. All differences are expressed as **`r SHORT_A` − `r SHORT_B`**. The two runs share the same EAU grid, benefit data (WMD totals), cost data, budget rule and solver settings; only the FOREsce land-cover scenario differs.

# Headline summary

```{r}
#| label: headline-text
#| include: false
txt_order <- if (order_all) {
  "The policy ranking (rolling first, myopic second, greedy third) **holds in every climate scenario under both land-cover scenarios**."
} else {
  "**The policy ranking (rolling first, myopic second, greedy third) does not hold in at least one climate scenario** — see the last column of the table below."
}
txt_flag <- if (n_flag == 0) {
  sprintf("No headline gap moves by more than the %g-percentage-point flag threshold (largest shift: %.1f pp).",
          THRESH_PP, max_shift)
} else {
  sprintf("**%d of 8 headline gaps move by more than %g percentage points** (largest shift: %.1f pp); these are highlighted in red below.",
          n_flag, THRESH_PP, max_shift)
}
```

`r txt_order`

- **Rolling vs. greedy:** `r rng0(clim$rg_imp_b)` improvement under `r SHORT_B`, `r rng0(clim$rg_imp_a)` under `r SHORT_A` (`r rngp(clim$rg_d_b)` vs. `r rngp(clim$rg_d_a)` additional pairs).
- **Rolling vs. myopic:** `r rng0(clim$rm_imp_b)` improvement under `r SHORT_B`, `r rng0(clim$rm_imp_a)` under `r SHORT_A`.
- **Shortfall of greedy relative to rolling:** `r rng0(clim$rg_short_b)` under `r SHORT_B`, `r rng0(clim$rg_short_a)` under `r SHORT_A`.
- **Rolling acquisition value** changes by `r sprintf("%+.1f%% to %+.1f%%", min(roll_chg), max(roll_chg))` across climate scenarios.

`r txt_flag`

```{r}
  rm_b = fmt_p1(clim$rm_imp_b), rm_a = fmt_p1(clim$rm_imp_a), rm_d = fmt_pp1(d_rm),

  bold_cells = flags,
  footer_text = c("% improvement = (rolling \u2212 comparison policy) as % of the comparison policy's acquisition value (as in Table 1 of the main results).",
                  paste0(DELTA, " pp = ", SHORT_A, " \u2212 ", SHORT_B, ", in percentage points. Red = shift larger than ", THRESH_PP, " pp.")))
```

```{r}
#| label: inputs-prep
#| include: false
#| eval: !expr have_panels
scen_of <- function(rcp, gcm) case_when(rcp == "stationary" ~ "stationary",
                                        rcp == "baseline"   ~ "baseline",
                                        TRUE                ~ paste0("rcp", rcp, "_", gcm))
benefit_of <- function(panel) bind_rows(
  panel %>% filter(year == 2020, rcp == "baseline") %>%
    transmute(eau_id, year, value = scaled_abundance) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(scenario = SCEN_LEVELS),
  panel %>% filter(year > 2020) %>%
    transmute(eau_id, year, scenario = scen_of(rcp, gcm), value = scaled_abundance)) %>%
  distinct(eau_id, year, scenario, .keep_all = TRUE)

ben_b <- benefit_of(B$panel); ben_a <- benefit_of(A$panel)
ben <- full_join(ben_b, ben_a, by = c("eau_id", "year", "scenario"), suffix = c("_b", "_a"))

## landscape totals: WMD totals are fixed by McKenna, so these should barely move
tot <- ben %>% group_by(scenario, year) %>%
  summarise(b = sum(value_b, na.rm = TRUE), a = sum(value_a, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(rel = 100 * (a - b) / b)
max_tot_shift <- max(abs(tot$rel), na.rm = TRUE)

## EAU coverage and cost
n_eau_b <- n_distinct(B$panel$eau_id); n_eau_a <- n_distinct(A$panel$eau_id)
cost_j <- inner_join(distinct(B$panel, eau_id, year, cost),
                     distinct(A$panel, eau_id, year, cost),
                     by = c("eau_id", "year"), suffix = c("_b", "_a"))
cost_maxdiff <- max(abs(cost_j$cost_a - cost_j$cost_b), na.rm = TRUE)

## risk (as Fig. 3: RCP 4.5/8.5 rows, 2100 excluded; floor = smallest positive stationary value)
risk_of <- function(panel) {
  sv  <- panel %>% filter(rcp == "stationary", year < 2100) %>% pull(trans_prob)
  eps <- if (any(sv > 0, na.rm = TRUE)) min(sv[sv > 0], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  r <- panel %>% distinct(eau_id, year, rcp, value = trans_prob) %>%
    filter(year < 2100, rcp %in% c("45", "85")) %>%
    mutate(rcp_lab = recode(rcp, `45` = "RCP 4.5", `85` = "RCP 8.5"),
           at_floor = value <= eps * 1.000001, pct = value * 100)
  list(r = r, eps = eps)
}
RB <- risk_of(B$panel); RA <- risk_of(A$panel)
rk <- bind_rows(RB$r %>% mutate(run = "b"), RA$r %>% mutate(run = "a")) %>%
  mutate(run = factor(run, levels = c("b", "a")))

## cumulative conversion probability over the modelled decades (2020 shared row +
## 2030–2090 RCP rows), the quantity the survival term S accumulates
cum_of <- function(panel) {
  h <- panel %>% distinct(eau_id, year, rcp, h = trans_prob) %>% filter(year < 2100)
  base20 <- h %>% filter(rcp == "baseline")
  bind_rows(lapply(c("45", "85"), function(k)
    bind_rows(base20, h %>% filter(rcp == k)) %>%
      distinct(eau_id, year, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% mutate(rcp_k = k))) %>%
    group_by(eau_id, rcp_k) %>%
    summarise(cum = 100 * (1 - prod(1 - h, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
}
cum <- inner_join(cum_of(B$panel), cum_of(A$panel), by = c("eau_id", "rcp_k"),
                  suffix = c("_b", "_a")) %>%
  mutate(d = cum_a - cum_b, rcp_lab = recode(rcp_k, `45` = "RCP 4.5", `85` = "RCP 8.5"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-benefit-diff
#| fig-cap: !expr cap_fig_benefit_diff
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| eval: !expr have_panels && have_xy
dm <- ben %>%
  filter((year == 2020 & scenario == "rcp45_wet") | (year == 2100 & scenario == BEN_MAP_SCEN)) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(ifelse(year == 2020, "2020 (shared baseline)",
                               paste0("2100 (", SCEN_LAB1[[BEN_MAP_SCEN]], ")")),
                        levels = c("2020 (shared baseline)",
                                   paste0("2100 (", SCEN_LAB1[[BEN_MAP_SCEN]], ")"))),
         d = value_a - value_b) %>%
  inner_join(eau_xy, by = "eau_id")
lim <- max(abs(dm$d), na.rm = TRUE); lim <- if (is.finite(lim) && lim > 0) lim else 1
ggplot(dm, aes(x_coord, y_coord, fill = d)) +
  geom_tile(width = CELL_W, height = CELL_H) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 2) + coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = DIV_LO, mid = "grey94", high = DIV_HI, midpoint = 0,
                       limits = c(-lim, lim), labels = label_comma(), na.value = "grey80",
                       name = paste0("Change in duck pairs per EAU (", SHORT_A, " minus ", SHORT_B, ")"),
                       guide = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", barwidth = 16, barheight = .6)) +
  theme_map()
```

```{r}
band <- bind_rows(ben_b %>% mutate(run = "b"), ben_a %>% mutate(run = "a")) %>%
  group_by(run, scenario, year) %>%
  summarise(p25 = quantile(value, .25, na.rm = TRUE), med = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            p75 = quantile(value, .75, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(run = factor(run, levels = c("b", "a")),
         scenario = factor(scenario, levels = SCEN_LEVELS))
ggplot(band, aes(year, med, colour = run, fill = run)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p25, ymax = p75), alpha = .15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .8) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, ncol = 5, labeller = as_labeller(SCEN_LAB1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = RUN_COL, labels = RUN_LAB, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = RUN_COL, labels = RUN_LAB, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous("year", breaks = seq(2020, 2100, 40)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Duck pairs per EAU", labels = label_comma()) +
  theme_cmp()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-benefit
#| tbl-cap: "How much the per-EAU duck distribution changes between land-cover runs."
#| eval: !expr have_panels
bs <- ben %>%
  filter(!is.na(value_b), !is.na(value_a),
         (year == 2020 & scenario == "rcp45_wet") | year == 2100) %>%
  mutate(row = ifelse(year == 2020, "2020 (shared baseline)",
                      paste0("2100 ", SCEN_LAB1[scenario])),
         ord = ifelse(year == 2020, 0, match(scenario, SCEN_LEVELS))) %>%
  group_by(row, ord) %>%
  summarise(r       = cor(value_b, value_a),
            med_pct = median(abs(value_a - value_b) / pmax(value_b, 1e-9) * 100),
            n10     = 100 * mean(abs(value_a - value_b) > 0.10 * pmax(value_b, 1e-9)),
            max_abs = max(abs(value_a - value_b)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(ord)
style_cmp_table(
  data.frame(Year = bs$row, r = sprintf("%.3f", bs$r), med = fmt_p1(bs$med_pct),
             n10 = fmt_p1(bs$n10), mx = fmt_pairs(bs$max_abs), check.names = FALSE),
  groups = rep("Per-EAU duck pairs", 4),
  subs = c("Correlation", "Median |change|", "EAUs changing >10%", "Largest |change| (pairs)"),
  first_lab = "Year / scenario",
  footer_text = "Correlation and changes are across EAUs, comparing the same EAU in both runs.")
```

## Acquisition value by policy

```{r}
#| label: tbl-va
#| tbl-cap: "Acquisition value (cumulative discounted duck-pairs secured relative to the do-nothing baseline, 2020–2100), by policy and land-cover run."
rel <- function(a, b) ifelse(abs(b) < 1, NA_real_, 100 * (a - b) / b)
style_cmp_table(
  data.frame(Scenario = scen_lab,
             g_b = fmt_pairs(cmp$greedy_b),  g_a = fmt_pairs(cmp$greedy_a),  g_d = fmt_rel(rel(cmp$greedy_a, cmp$greedy_b)),
             m_b = fmt_pairs(cmp$myopic_b),  m_a = fmt_pairs(cmp$myopic_a),  m_d = fmt_rel(rel(cmp$myopic_a, cmp$myopic_b)),
             r_b = fmt_pairs(cmp$rolling_b), r_a = fmt_pairs(cmp$rolling_a), r_d = fmt_rel(rel(cmp$rolling_a, cmp$rolling_b)),
             check.names = FALSE),
  groups = rep(c("Greedy", "Myopic", "Rolling"), each = 3),
  subs = rep(c(SHORT_B, SHORT_A, paste0(DELTA, "%")), 3),
  footer_text = paste0(DELTA, "% = change in acquisition value, ", SHORT_A, " relative to ", SHORT_B, "."))
```

## Relative performance over time (Fig. 5)

```{r}
#| label: fig-overtime
#| fig-cap: !expr cap_fig_overtime
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
cumg_of <- function(trj) {
  roll <- trj %>% filter(model == "rolling") %>% select(scenario, year, roll = discounted)
  trj %>% filter(model %in% c("greedy", "myopic"), scenario %in% CLIM) %>%
    left_join(roll, by = c("scenario", "year")) %>%
    arrange(scenario, model, year) %>% group_by(scenario, model) %>%
    mutate(cum_gap = cumsum(discounted - roll)) %>% ungroup()
}
cg <- bind_rows(cumg_of(B$trj) %>% mutate(run = "b"), cumg_of(A$trj) %>% mutate(run = "a")) %>%
  mutate(run = factor(run, levels = c("b", "a")), scenario = factor(scenario, levels = CLIM))
ggplot(cg, aes(year, cum_gap, colour = model, linetype = run,
               group = interaction(model, run))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = COL_MODEL[["rolling"]], linewidth = .8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .8) + geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, ncol = 2, labeller = as_labeller(SCEN_LAB1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COL_MODEL, labels = c(greedy = "Greedy", myopic = "Myopic"), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(b = "solid", a = "22"), labels = RUN_LAB, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous("Cumulative difference vs. rolling\n(discounted duck-pairs)", labels = label_comma()) +
  scale_x_continuous("year") +
  theme_cmp() + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-overlap
#| tbl-cap: "Overlap of the EAUs each policy acquires under the two land-cover runs."
#| eval: !expr have_sched
acq_ids <- function(sch, sc, m)
  unique(sch$eau_id[sch$scenario == sc & sch$model == m & !is.na(sch$acquired_year)])
ov <- expand_grid(scenario = CLIM, model = c("greedy", "myopic", "rolling")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(n_b = length(acq_ids(B$sch, scenario, model)),
         n_a = length(acq_ids(A$sch, scenario, model)),
         shared = length(intersect(acq_ids(B$sch, scenario, model), acq_ids(A$sch, scenario, model))),
         jac = shared / max(1, length(union(acq_ids(B$sch, scenario, model), acq_ids(A$sch, scenario, model))))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(n_b, n_a, shared, jac))
style_cmp_table(
  data.frame(Scenario = unname(SCEN_LAB1[ov$scenario]),
             g_b = ov$n_b_greedy,  g_a = ov$n_a_greedy,  g_s = ov$shared_greedy,  g_j = sprintf("%.2f", ov$jac_greedy),
             m_b = ov$n_b_myopic,  m_a = ov$n_a_myopic,  m_s = ov$shared_myopic,  m_j = sprintf("%.2f", ov$jac_myopic),
             r_b = ov$n_b_rolling, r_a = ov$n_a_rolling, r_s = ov$shared_rolling, r_j = sprintf("%.2f", ov$jac_rolling),
             check.names = FALSE),
  groups = rep(c("Greedy", "Myopic", "Rolling"), each = 4),
  subs = rep(c(paste("n", SHORT_B), paste("n", SHORT_A), "shared", "Jaccard"), 3),
  footer_text = "n = EAUs acquired 2020\u20132100. Jaccard = shared / acquired by either run (1 = identical sets, 0 = no overlap).")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-rolling-sets
#| fig-cap: !expr cap_fig_rolling_sets
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 9
#| eval: !expr have_sched
land <- B$sch %>% distinct(eau_id, x_coord, y_coord)
SET_COL <- setNames(c("#5E4FA2", "#6B8EAD", "#C0392B", "grey91"),
                    c("Both runs", paste(SHORT_B, "only"), paste(SHORT_A, "only"), "Neither"))
rs_map <- bind_rows(lapply(CLIM, function(sc) {
  rb <- acq_ids(B$sch, sc, "rolling"); ra <- acq_ids(A$sch, sc, "rolling")
  land %>% mutate(scenario = sc, cat = case_when(
    eau_id %in% rb & eau_id %in% ra ~ "Both runs",
    eau_id %in% rb                  ~ paste(SHORT_B, "only"),
    eau_id %in% ra                  ~ paste(SHORT_A, "only"),
    TRUE                            ~ "Neither"))
})) %>%
  mutate(cat = factor(cat, levels = names(SET_COL)),
         scenario = factor(scenario, levels = CLIM))
ggplot(rs_map, aes(x_coord, y_coord, fill = cat)) +
  geom_tile(width = CELL_W, height = CELL_H) +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, ncol = 2, labeller = as_labeller(SCEN_LAB1)) + coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SET_COL, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme_map()
```
